next_experiment.name: post-buyback net-and-gross inline boundary
next_experiment.mechanism: Expand finish_v3_buy_costs backwards so the inline helper owns first add3, optional second add3, checked net addition/subtraction, pre_fee_amount, fee subtraction, and the final three-value Result.
